title: Patient-based screening register of a consecutive patient cohort for cystic pancreatic masses (Magdeburg cyst passport concept)
summary: Using a patient pass, newly discovered and follow-up findings of pancreatic tumors with the character of cysts as well as patients who have already undergone surgery and their follow-up care should be documented in more detail. This means that available findings can always be accessed and a progress assessment can be carried out as required. This makes it easier for the supervising and treating doctors to communicate and work together. Furthermore, simultaneous data collection in a computer-based directory allows scientific processing and interpretation.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with cystic pancreatic tumor lesions detected twice by imaging (complementary diagnostic procedures) and/or histologically proven
Exclusion criteria:
- without evidence of a pancreatic tumor lesion
- with pseudocyst
- with manifest pancreatic cancer
- < 18 years
